allow: PowerShell($r='repos/BLEND360/blendx-aws-foundry-infra/contents'; foreach \($p in 'hub/scripts/deploy/harness/point-harness-alias.sh','hub/scripts/deploy/harness/wait-harness-ready.sh','.github/workflows/_harness-deployment.yml'\) { "===== $p"; gh api "$r/$p" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" }; "===== tree"; gh api "$r/hub/harnesses/project_assistant" --jq '.[].path')

PowerShell($r='repos/BLEND360/blendx-aws-foundry-infra/contents'; "===== get-harness-version"; gh api "$r/hub/scripts/deploy/harness/get-harness-version.sh" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw"; "===== harness.json"; gh api "$r/hub/harnesses/project_assistant/app" --jq '.[].path'; gh api "$r/hub/harnesses/project_assistant/app/project_assistant/harness.json" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw"; "===== agentcore dir"; gh api "$r/hub/harnesses/project_assistant/agentcore" --jq '.[].path'; "===== roles grep"; gh api "$r/infra/roles/definitions.py" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" | Select-String -Pattern 'harness|Harness' -Context 0,0 | Select-Object -First 40)

PowerShell($t = gh api repos/BLEND360/blendx-aws-foundry-infra/contents/infra/roles/definitions.py -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw"; $t | Set-Content "$env:TEMP\\foundry_roles.py"; $lines = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\foundry_roles.py"; $i = \($lines | Select-String 'AllowReadHarnessOutputs|AllowManageHarnessEndpoints' | Select-Object -First 1\).LineNumber; $lines[\($i-15\)..\($i+45\)]; "==========="; $j = \($lines | Select-String 'agentcore_harness_role = RoleSpec'\).LineNumber; $lines[\($j-30\)..\($j+110\)])

PowerShell($t = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\st15-out\\AgentCore-myapp-default.template.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "--- resources"; $t.Resources.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.Name\)  $\($_.Value.Type\)" }; "--- outputs"; $t.Outputs.PSObject.Properties.Name; "--- harness props"; \($t.Resources.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Value.Type -eq 'AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Harness' }\).Value.Properties | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6)
PowerShell(gh issue list --state open --search "ST-03 in:title" --json number,title,url --jq '.[] | "#\\\(.number\) \\\(.title\) \\\(.url\)"')
